title: Add match history and step-through replay

pr.title: Add match history and step-through replay
pr.body:
## Summary
- Adds a flag-gated history page so a player can list finished matches and step through each one on the existing board.
- Stores a board snapshot on each ply while `match-replay` is on, and returns 404/409 when a replay is missing, still in progress, or has an incomplete log.
- Emits API and web success, error, and duration metrics for history loads and replays.

## Test plan
- [ ] With `NODE_ENV=development`, sign in, finish a game, and open History.
- [ ] Step previous and next through the replay and confirm the last frame shows the result.
- [ ] Open a match played before the flag was on and confirm the incomplete-replay error.
- [ ] Confirm the history link is hidden when `match-replay` is off.


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)

commitMessage:
Run local dev as development so replay flags apply.

Unset NODE_ENV made the API harness treat Docker and host dev as production, so history returned Not found.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

Add match history and step-through replay.

Players can review finished games, and error metrics cover missing, in-progress, and incomplete replays.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
